scene_custom.model_identity: photo-led explanatory reconstruction; not GT; approximate remote boundary
scene_custom.glazing_model: Coplanar full main glazed run with tangent-continuous curved terminal glass and rails; inferred remote enclosure
scene_custom.refinement_note: Photo-supported explanatory refinement. Refer to case notes and current correction records; source parameters are input history, not necessarily final geometry.
scene_custom.topology_basis: Wood/window/gray-wall placement, lengths, orientation and right return to(4.4,3) are explanatory estimates. No global multi-view registration. Backside region beyond terminal wall is excluded from floor/roof; no invented room behind it. Curved glass endpoint remains approximate hand-read photo interpretation.
scene_custom.source_identity_status: No calibrated camera pose or global registration. Near placement constrained by source-facing direction, timber/glass-side relation and window adjacency, not measured coordinates. Far wood size and right return remain approximate. Open unresolved sections intentionally distinguish absence of evidence from a confirmed opening.
scene_custom.furnishing_scope: Photo-supported near/dining/far furnishing groups. Distinct far seating not copied from near lounge. All dimensions explanatory estimates; retained wall corner remains unverified.
scene_custom.far_corner_evidence: Coplanar hypothesis following user preference and ordinary construction, not direct photo confirmation. See coplanar_corner_final.json.
